Lost response after successful write preserves client input; identical retry succeeds without a second revision or false conflict.

A concurrent different update returns 409, keeps the local draft, and preserves the other writer's value.
Read-cloud action fetches a new value written after page load, without needing a prior conflict response.
Read-cloud 503 preserves unsaved input and reports failure.
Successful cloud read following a conflict replaces input with the latest saved text and clears the old error.
